title: Stage III Community-based Efficacy Trial for Mothering From the Inside Out
brief_summary: This is a Stage III community-based randomized clinical efficacy trial testing Mothering from the Inside Out (MIO), the first evidence-based parenting intervention designed to be delivered by addiction counselors in addiction treatment settings where parents of young children are enrolled in treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English-speaking female adults (18-65 years of age)
* Receiving outpatient substance abuse treatment services at the APT Foundation
* Caring for at least one child between 11 and 60 months of age
* Express interest in receiving assistance with parenting

Exclusion Criteria:

* Actively suicidal, homicidal, or severe cognitive impairment
